summary: CBL International Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, reporting unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, and announcing a special cash dividend of $0.10 per share on both Class A and Class B ordinary shares. The dividend is payable September 18, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 28, 2026. The board declared the dividend on the filing date. This capital-return action is the sole special-situation event; the rest of the filing comprises routine financial disclosures. No advisers or strategic alternatives were mentioned. Watch for continued capital-return initiatives or changes in cash-distribution policy.
